scheme: local inertial (Bates et al. 2010) on sub-grid storage cells; outflow limited to cell volume; dt = 0.7 dx / sqrt(g d_max) <= 300 s
boundary: cells outside the depression with median terrain < 3.0 m carry the reconstruction's surface (daily at 12:00 UTC, linear)
consistency: within a factor 2 of the observed area on 7, 9, 13 June (<= 0.5 km2 where observed < 0.25) -- a check, not a fit
not_modelled: rain; groundwater; culverts / drainage structures; sub-daily river surface; vegetation-specific roughness
